matt.sanders: quick handoff — BeaconPay (midmarket). Contract signed; wants private VPC eval + SSO. Estimated steady-state ~50M tokens/mo; pilot target week of May 4. Renewal note: term 12mo, renewal in ~11mo, customer asking about sustained RPS/latency SLAs. Sales demo recording: https://redwood.app/rec/beaconpay-demo . Key contacts: sara@beaconpay (POC), devops@beaconpay. Passing to CS for onboarding + to eng/support for SSO + private deploy planning. tl;dr: pilot timeline, SSO connector, infra sizing, onboarding playbook, success metrics. Matt -> Priya for CS. Thanks :pray:

priya.kapoor: thanks @matt.sanders — taking point. I'll own onboarding plan, enablement sessions, and playbook. First 2 weeks: provision dedicated sandbox, run onboarding workshop, collect sample prompts & eval set. Can you drop SAML metadata + test IdP account and a sample API key? Also please confirm customer availability for a kickoff (week of Apr 27). I'll loop eng/support into the SSO/runbook call.

elena_castro: support here — will own the SSO connector support and ops runbook. Need SAML metadata, IdP test account, and to confirm whether they want SCIM user sync. Also what's their preferred auth: SAML or OIDC?

jamal_wu: eng ack — private deployment estimate for ~50M tokens/mo with p99 latency target ~250ms: recommend 2x A100-class nodes + burst pool and persistent KV cache. Need network peering details, CIDR ranges, and KMS/HSM tenant info. Timeline: ~3 weeks to stand up private VPC + smoke tests if we get infra creds this week; on-prem would add 2–4 weeks.

priya.kapoor: action items summarized: (1) matt.sanders: add SAML metadata + IdP test account + contact hours; (2) matt.sanders: confirm billing contact and legal for private deploy; (3) elena_castro: open support ticket with SSO checklist; (4) jamal_wu: draft capacity & infra estimate doc. I'll build onboarding checklist, schedule workshop, and capture success metrics.

matt.sanders: added SAML metadata and IdP test creds to thread (see attachment). Billing contact: erin@beaconpay, legal: legal@beaconpay. Demo link: https://redwood.app/rec/beaconpay-demo . Uploaded initial prompt set to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake

elena_castro: opened ticket INC-4521 and attached SSO checklist; tagging @jamal_wu for infra validation. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INC-4521 — SSO onboarding; owner: elena_castro; priority: P2.

jamal_wu: noted. I'll post the capacity doc by EOD tomorrow and attach node sizing + cost estimate. Can we lock the kickoff for Apr 28 10:00am PT? Priya / Matt, are you good?

priya.kapoor: Apr 28 10:00am PT works for me, adding invite now. Success metrics for pilot: 2-week pilot, 95% of eval prompts completed, <3% error rate, and latency <300ms p95. I'll add these to the runbook.

matt.sanders: perfect — leaving the handoff to @priya.kapoor. Ping me if anything blocks on legal/billing. :rocket:
